checks.name: Keyboard focus uses a visible shared outline

checks: Midnight and System preferences survive reload; System reacts to OS color scheme changes
Real normal signup creates only an isolated organization administrator; no sourcing or approval authority
Digital Scion omits physical scope and supplier offers; physical Scion still renders both workflows
Persisted synthetic agent and skill render across configuration; disconnected worker remains accurate and no task was dispatched
Appearance is shared between workspace and public demo, including storage-event updates across tabs
Current/revised/revoked database demo states preserved; stale details and revoked evidence remain withheld; demo does not change login cookies
Offline demo clears live nodes and honestly displays disconnection in both palettes
